newsitem.title: UK: Next gains as Oasis results please.
newsitem.headline: Next gains as Oasis results please.

text.p: Shares in fashion retailer Next Plc rose to a near-record high in early trade on Tuesday, boosted by good figures from rival Oasis Stores Plc and other recent results in the sector, dealers said.
Next shares were up 11p at 628 by 0751 GMT after earlier reaching a high of 632p, near its peak of 639p set March 13.
Volume was a moderate 186,790 shares, with some market-makers saying the price was squeezed higher by a shortage of stock in the market.

Oasis was up 11p at 397-1/2 after reporting a 42 percent rise in pre-tax profit to 15.6 million stg on sales up 33.5 percent at 81.6 million. Chairman Michael Bennett said same-store sales were up seven percent.
Dealers said the Oasis results provided further evidence that leading fashion store chains were benefitting most from current strength in consumer demand.
"Next is reflecting the Oasis figures," said one senior trader. "It's assuming that if companies like Oasis are doing well then Next must be too."

Elsewhere in the sector Moss Bros Group Plc was up 2-1/2p at 14.00 stg, after yesterday rising 15p after the group -- which includes the Cecil Gee and Blazer chains -- reported a 41 percent rise in yearly pre-tax profit to 15.9 million stg.
